name: CW Core Specification Set
purpose: Pin one immutable CCF + NodeTypes + Rulesets interpretation bundle. Alternate compatible bundles may select different NodeTypes and Rulesets while consuming the same CW canonical import format.
rules: The bundle selects interpretation authority explicitly; filenames and latest/current discovery are not semantic authority.
Importers produce CW canonical data only. Specification selection happens after import.
Changing the selected specification set changes an evaluation context and MUST NOT silently rewrite the canonical model.
